items.title: Lavender
items.text: A calm purple flower. Grows slowly but gives double crops when harvested fully mature.

items.title: Mint
items.text: Fast growing herb. Likes moist soil and spreads quickly, so remember to water it.

items.title: Sunny
items.text: Clear sky. Soil dries faster, so plants need more watering.

items.title: Rain
items.text: Real rain outside means rain on your balcony. Moisture goes up on its own.

items.title: Loam
items.text: Balanced soil with good water retention. A safe choice for any starter pot.
